Name: Tsum Tsum Script - ALPHA
Message:
**Changes**
1. Longer chains, with a new "Link reach" setting
2. New skill: Formal Suit Beast
3. Better timing for Cpt. Lightyear
4. "Clear Bubbles" is now a three-way "Bubble Strategy"
5. Settings changes now apply mid-run
6. Settings now shows what will run, and when
7. Auto Send Hearts now sweeps your whole ranking
8. Rank-up and record panels no longer hide your score
9. Round stats now record the tsum played and the coins earned
10. Round stats go in a separate file for each day
11. The floating bar names the tsum being played
12. Round stats can be shared if you switch it on in the app, never double-counted

_USE WITH CAUTION_
